from src.semver.version import Version

# Test bump_build cases
test_cases = [
    ('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9', '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10'),
    ('3.4.5-rc.1+0009.dev', '3.4.5-rc.1+0010.dev'),
    ('3.4.5-rc.1', '3.4.5-rc.1+build.1'),
    ('3.4.5', '3.4.5+build.1'),
]

for version_str, expected in test_cases:
    v = Version.parse(version_str)
    result = v.bump_build()
    status = "✓" if str(result) == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {version_str} -> {result} (expected {expected})")

print()

# Test m1 observable cases for bump_prerelease
prerelease_cases = [
    ('1.0.0-rc9', '1.0.0-rc9.0'),
    ('1.0.0-rc.9', '1.0.0-rc.10'),
    ('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0-alpha.0'),
]

for version_str, expected in prerelease_cases:
    v = Version.parse(version_str)
    result = v.bump_prerelease()
    status = "✓" if str(result) == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {version_str} -> {result} (expected {expected})")

print()

# Test m2 observable cases for bump_build
build_cases = [
    ('1.2.3+alpha', '1.2.3+alpha.0'),
    ('1.2.3+build.9', '1.2.3+build.10'),
    ('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9', '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10'),
]

for version_str, expected in build_cases:
    v = Version.parse(version_str)
    result = v.bump_build()
    status = "✓" if str(result) == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {version_str} -> {result} (expected {expected})")
